synthesis: The Repos stat tile in the Scout Org Map stat bar (MapStatsBar.vue) is hidden only on compact (mobile) screens while in live/Today view. Dalton says desktop should match; separately the metric is being pulled because repos_affected only makes sense for Direct Live hits (staging excluded). Tension: literal 'match mobile' = hide in live/Today on ALL breakpoints (still shows in historical ranges); ticket's stated recommendation = hide ENTIRELY (all breakpoints + ranges). The ticket flags this as an open question that changes the diff.

scope.summary: Change the conditional array-spread guard around the Repos tile in MapStatsBar.vue so desktop also hides it, per the chosen rule. Tile is one item in a v-for'd flex array, so array membership is the only lever — no separate layout/gap change needed.

proposed_changes.change: Modify the guard at line 193 per the resolved question: (a) MIRROR mobile → drop the `isCompact.value &&` clause → `...(!mapStore.liveMode ? [{...}] : [])` (hidden in live/Today on all breakpoints, still shown in historical ranges on both); or (b) HIDE ENTIRELY → remove the Repos push (or gate permanently false) so it never renders on any breakpoint/range.
proposed_changes.reason: Single render site of the Org Map Repos tile; array-based v-for means dropping the object removes tile + its flex cell + its border-l divider together, no gap.

questions.answer: Hide ENTIRELY — remove the Repos tile on all breakpoints and all date ranges until the direct/staging split is sorted.

notes: DEV-2106 commit that added the guard explicitly said 'hide Repos tile on compact+Today only (MapStatsBar, desktop unchanged)' — desktop-unchanged was a deliberate original decision, not necessarily an oversight. Worth confirming intent.
Reuse the existing conditional-array-spread idiom (like Trips' `auth.tripsEnabled`), NOT v-show/CSS hiding, so no orphaned flex cell / border-l divider is left.
